title: Capture the day-one corpus: 10 rooms and 5 tabletop builds
summary: The Owner scans 10 rooms and 5 tabletop builds with the phone camera app so M1 has a corpus on day one (kit §10 step 4). Raw video goes to gj-capture through the corpus intake path, never into git.

acceptance_tests.test: 10 room walkthrough videos (1–3 min each, chest-height arc, good light) and 5 tabletop orbital videos (slow circle at two heights), phone camera app, handed over per services/reconstruction/corpus/README.md.
At least 3 rooms include the Bible §1 furniture classes (couch, coffee table, dining chair, bookshelf) and at least 2 tabletops are Lego builds.
No faces, documents, screens with personal data, or addresses are visible; GPS off during capture.
acceptance_tests.evidence: Owner confirmation line in the manifest PR
